column2: Every competitor ranks for 'hospital + locality' queries. 'Near me' searches drive 40–60% of first appointments in healthcare (2026 industry studies).
column3: Kokapet has no hospital brand owning 'hospital Kokapet', 'maternity Kokapet', 'paediatrician Kokapet' yet. Capture this before Medicover's Kokapet launch.

column2: Ankura, Rainbow, Arete all pushing doctor-led Reels; educational + relatable tone; 2–3 posts/week minimum.
column3: Founder-doctors are our biggest moat. Launch a weekly Reels calendar from Day 1 — educational first, promotional second.

column2: Arete (4.7), Rainbow (4.4) and Continental (4.5) dominate local pack. Clinics with 100+ reviews & 4.5+ rating capture 70%+ of map-pack clicks.
column3: Target 500+ Google reviews in year 1 via structured post-discharge ask-flow + QR codes on discharge summaries.

column2: Every competitor sells packages (maternity, health check-up, annual). Package pages convert 3–5x better than general pages.
column3: Build 'Family Health Passport' + 'Mother & Baby Platinum' + 'Executive Well-Woman' packages with transparent pricing.

column2: Click-to-WhatsApp on every competitor's mobile site; response SLAs 5–30 min; WhatsApp Business API lead-routing common.
column3: Deploy WhatsApp Business API from Day 1 with sub-15-minute response SLA — and market that SLA.

column2: Dr Nageshwar Reddy (AIG), Dr Guru Reddy (Continental), Dr Krishna Prasad (Ankura) all leverage personal brand for pull. Patients follow doctors, not hospitals.
column3: Unicare's practicing-founder setup is rare. Each founder-doctor should have their own Instagram (handle-led) + LinkedIn + YouTube Shorts.

column2: Medicover, Care, Continental run dedicated corporate desks and health-check events on office campuses.
column3: Kokapet has Microsoft, TCS, Amazon, Deloitte campuses within 5 km. Build a Corporate Health Partnership team in quarter 2.

column2: Every competitor lists 50+ TPAs. Cashless is now expected in 2026.
column3: Fast-track TPA empanelment; publish cashless-TPA list on homepage and above-the-fold in Facebook ads.

column2: Apollo, Medicover, Continental all run branded telemed via app or web; ~5–10% of OPDs now digital.
column3: Offer lightweight telemed via WhatsApp video for follow-ups — no app needed; frictionless differentiator.

column2: Generic hospital content ranks poorly. Google prioritises named-author articles (doctor by-line), credentials, structured FAQs.
column3: All blog content must be authored (and photographed) by a named doctor; schema mark-up for MedicalOrganization + Physician.

column2: Most use the same phrases: 'compassionate care', 'world-class', 'excellence'. Reviews show actual experience is uneven.
column3: Use specific, provable claims: 'Founder-doctor sees every first consult', 'Doctor call-back guaranteed in 2 hours', 'Zero-wait OPD for antenatal patients'.

column2: Himagiri, Pranaam, Citizens all score <70 on PageSpeed; large hero images, no CTA above the fold, broken WhatsApp buttons.
column3: Unicare's site must score 90+ on mobile PageSpeed; WhatsApp + Call CTAs always visible; appointment flow ≤3 steps.

column2: Many hospitals post only 1–2x a week; no content system; doctors' LinkedIns abandoned.

column2: Most lead forms ask for name + phone with no value exchange. Conversion stays low.
column3: Offer real lead magnets: 'Free pregnancy nutrition plan', 'Free paediatric vaccination tracker', 'Free posture assessment for WFH professionals'.

column2: Local GPs are the biggest referral source but no competitor has a formal GP referral programme.
column3: Launch 'Unicare Partner GP Network' — monthly CME dinners, referral dashboard, unified digital case-notes.
